achievements.name: Home is Behind
achievements.desc: The old monkey has told his tale. Onward you must go.

achievements.name: Hammer and Hew
achievements.desc: Armed head to toe, dread not the foe.

achievements.name: Warring with Wolves
achievements.desc: False is his name. Slay him all the same!

achievements.name: Absorb and Cultivate
achievements.desc: Consume those who had consumed.

achievements.name: Brew of Bravery
achievements.desc: Fresh brew in an old cask. May it stir a great task!

achievements.name: Slithering Snake
achievements.desc: The white-clad one pled his case. Spare him some days of grace.

achievements.name: Handy and Hardy
achievements.desc: A good match calls for a good weapon.

achievements.name: Enduring Echoes
achievements.desc: Three bells sound, lost souls bound.

achievements.name: Temple of Taint
achievements.desc: Now at an end is the elder's long wait for the journeyer.

achievements.name: Blazing Black Wind
achievements.desc: Of all things to learn, you chose to play with fire?

achievements.name: Creative Concoction
achievements.desc: Tonics are well and good, but not to be wolfed like food!

achievements.name: Cursed Clan
achievements.desc: A whole nest of rats scatters and falls.

achievements.name: Cage of Claws
achievements.desc: Smoke rises high, his doom shall arrive.

achievements.name: Sound in Stone
achievements.desc: No words of kind. Pay them no mind.

achievements.name: Death in Despair
achievements.desc: Resonant waves profound, he is now buried in the ground.

achievements.name: The Stone's Secret
achievements.desc: This odd boulder has something curious inside.

achievements.name: Oṃ Maṇi Padme Hūm
achievements.desc: Search each Buddha's head; in this perilous land, stones reside.

achievements.name: Buried in the Sand
achievements.desc: The tiger, the child, both lost in the wild.

achievements.name: Gleams of Gold
achievements.desc: The drunk said there's gold here. Do you believe him?

achievements.name: The Tiger Family
achievements.desc: The brothers and their father. You've met them all.

achievements.name: Shifting Sands
achievements.desc: The beetle came with drumbeats' call, and left with waves' gentle fall.

achievements.name: Precious Pills
achievements.desc: In furnace there is fire, and in fire there are pills.

achievements.name: A Great Gust
achievements.desc: There will be more sages if their maker still engages.

achievements.name: Thousand-Mile Quest
achievements.desc: Oh woe, oh woe, long trails they did go.

achievements.name: Voice Vanquished
achievements.desc: Red eyes mark wrong chants. The scripture needs amends.

achievements.name: Karma of Kang-Jin
achievements.desc: Now one less dwells in the dome of stars.

achievements.name: Boundless Bitterness
achievements.desc: Evening light on snow, rigidity ends in woe.

achievements.name: Shell and Scales
achievements.desc: To die is as woeful as to live alone.

achievements.name: Secret in the Scroll
achievements.desc: Near the hut the crops thrive; in the Painted Realm, their hearts lie.

achievements.name: Pound and Perfect
achievements.desc: "Through fire, armor is refined; through trials, strength is defined."

achievements.name: The Soaring Slash
achievements.desc: A mere test of skill turned into a fight for the kill.

achievements.name: Happy Harvest
achievements.desc: Fields kept trim leave time to skim.

achievements.name: Marvelous Melon
achievements.desc: A quirky man, a vanished melon patch; a marvelous spell, and an unexpected meeting.

achievements.name: Lust and Dust
achievements.desc: Each and every one holds their own truth.

achievements.name: Corrupted Captains
achievements.desc: How mighty would those four spirits be if I could harness their power?

achievements.name: Devoted Disciples
achievements.desc: Such a waste of those four grand titles.

achievements.name: Matches with the Macaque
achievements.desc: You don't need to wait for the perfect moment to soar to greater heights.

achievements.name: Nifty Nonsense
achievements.desc: The fat monk failed, for he spoke too much.

achievements.name: Mud on His Face
achievements.desc: An odd yaoguai killed, an odd mirror earned.

achievements.name: Gnashing Grudge
achievements.desc: Harsh, rash, ever unquelled. Rank, dank, muck-impelled.

achievements.name: Passion Passes
achievements.desc: Not even one of them looked back.

achievements.name: The Loong Pattern
achievements.desc: In the air they swing, yet it's already ending.

achievements.name: Secret in Purple Cloud
achievements.desc: "What use are eight arms against twenty strikes with my staff?"

achievements.name: The Wayward Ways
achievements.desc: "Is that ugliness a promise of immortality? Better leave it."

achievements.name: A Family Finished
achievements.desc: Together at last, the scorpions united.

achievements.name: The Cockerel Crowed
achievements.desc: Long and short, far and near, each span has its year.

achievements.name: Misfit with Merit
achievements.desc: Never will she see with him the world beyond.

achievements.name: Behold the Betrayal
achievements.desc: More eyes do not see more than the mortal trifles.

achievements.name: Always Accompanied
achievements.desc: How odd to encounter this old man at every corner!

achievements.name: The Furnace Boy
achievements.desc: Ha! A devoted Daoist should not be so polished!

achievements.name: Urge Unfulfilled
achievements.desc: "With my life I'll repay the title he gave me!"

achievements.name: Seeds to Sow
achievements.desc: Take more as fruit as your plants take root.

achievements.name: Souls in the Stalks
achievements.desc: You've picked them all, the easy ones and the hard ones.

achievements.name: A Willing Warrior
achievements.desc: "For his recognition, I'd give my life for him."

achievements.name: Scenic Seeker
achievements.desc: The most marvelous places for meditation have all met your gaze.

achievements.name: Three Teams of Two
achievements.desc: The six valiant captains who only fight in number.

achievements.name: With Full Spirit
achievements.desc: Their mighty Spirits are now gathered within you.

achievements.name: Frost and Flame
achievements.desc: The merging of ice and fire, swift and severe.

achievements.name: Flaming Fury
achievements.desc: The golden child brought fire and smoke; when they cleared, the family broke.

achievements.name: Treasure Trove
achievements.desc: "All the four vessels now belong to me!"

achievements.name: Mei of Memory
achievements.desc: Bonds from bygone days still pull at the heart.

achievements.name: Meet the Match
achievements.desc: "Let go of him, and you let go of all."

achievements.name: Full of Forms
achievements.desc: Each guise grants a new horizon.

achievements.name: Brews and Barrels
achievements.desc: Now you can sate yourself with all the drinks.

achievements.name: The Cloud Claimed
achievements.desc: Wings alone pale beside this greater gift!

achievements.name: The Clamor of Frogs
achievements.desc: Six frogs, six skills—how intriguing!

achievements.name: A Curious Collection
achievements.desc: Every rare wonder the world can offer, collected and kept.

achievements.name: The Five Skandhas
achievements.desc: This powerful pill still carries her caring wish.

achievements.name: Medicine Meal
achievements.desc: "Here, have it, have it all."

achievements.name: Treaded Tracks
achievements.desc: "Call off the chase! You've crushed every yaoguai here..."

achievements.name: Guardian of Gear
achievements.desc: You are fully fitted. Now, swing that staff and fight!

achievements.name: A Duel of Destiny
achievements.desc: Two minds' long fray leaves but one to stay.

achievements.name: Portraits Perfected
achievements.desc: Humans, beasts, yaoguais, and the Bodhisattvas. All recorded and noted.

achievements.name: Six Senses Secured
achievements.desc: After all that strife and struggle, what's truly been gained?

achievements.name: Master of Magic
achievements.desc: All spells we know are derived from the same source.

achievements.name: Gourds Gathered
achievements.desc: Rare is not the gourd but a friend to drink with.

achievements.name: Page Preserver
achievements.desc: "All the tattered pages can now be compiled in full."

achievements.name: Brewer's Bounty
achievements.desc: A blend for every brew to bring out its best.

achievements.name: Mantled with Might
achievements.desc: Shoes on feet, hat on head, embroidered shirt, Daoist robe—free as can be, doing as you please!

achievements.name: Staffs and Spears
achievements.desc: A walking vault of arms you have become!

achievements.name: Final Fulfillment
achievements.desc: Each ordeal paves your path to what you are meant to be.
